title: CRISPR 2.0 in Clinicals
description: Next-gen gene editing shows success in reversing hereditary blindness.

content.text: Clinical trials for a new prime-editing technique have shown significant recovery in patients with LCA10.

content.label: The Result
content.text: 70% of participants reported improved light perception.

content.label: Safety
content.text: No off-target mutations were detected in the treated retinal cells.
